column4: cleat#2249: this test guards on CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which ci.yml's test-go/plugins job sets nowhere (that job's env is CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_CRASH_DB only, postgres service, no mysql or mssql service) -- so it skips once in this job while PostgreSQL-backed tests run. Dialect-gated, not a hidden failure: the test itself (plugins/auditlog/audit_rows_are_scoped_to_their_tenant_mssql_test.go) is the cleat#2714 MSSQL counterpart to a PostgreSQL-only sibling, and has no PostgreSQL arm to fall back to. Measured by NAME on this job's own run (job 110223348903, PR #2883): exactly one skip event for this test, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL/CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL both unset and CLEAT_TEST_DB pointing at the job's postgres service.
